confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from a few mixed-date aggregated guides (TripBase, Oysterlist, 3pulse, a traveller report) that conflict on beer and coffee, so they are rough bounds. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Hampi context, not checked against live listings. Beer and coffee are the least certain food anchors. The FX observation was taken from a secondary aggregator that reports the RBA 4pm mid-point for 18 Nov 2026; the rba.gov.au page was not directly read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Low-cost rural Indian tourist town; priced against budget Indian tourist towns and rural Southeast Asia, with cost-of-living sources describing Hampi as significantly cheaper than most Indian cities. Drink prices are higher than local food prices, and beer and wine are less available. Wine is estimated at a premium over beer, with no direct local wine price data.
